details.description: Command Light is Cohere's smaller, faster sibling to its original Command model: an instruction-following text-generation model for conversational and summarization tasks, with a 4,000-token context window. On Amazon Bedrock it is offered as cohere.command-light-text-v14 under 1-month or 6-month commitment pricing. Cohere's own documentation marks both Command and Command Light as deprecated as of September 15, 2025, directing users to its current model lineup instead.
advantages: Cohere describes it as 'a smaller, faster version of command', prioritizing speed over the larger Command model.
Responds well to instruction-like prompts and supports both Cohere's Chat and Summarize APIs, per Cohere's documentation.
disadvantages: Cohere's documentation marks Command and Command Light as deprecated as of September 15, 2025.
4,000-token context window and 4,000-token max output are small next to current models.
Text only, per Cohere's documentation, which lists no vision or other modality support.

Not in Amazon Bedrock's current 'Models at a glance' listing, which as of September 2026 includes only Rerank 3.5, Command R, Command R+, and Cohere's embedding models, suggesting it has also reached end-of-life on Bedrock.
use_cases: Conversational, instruction-following text generation, per Cohere's documentation.
Text summarization via Cohere's Summarize API, per Cohere's documentation.
Lower-latency applications where speed is prioritized over the larger Command model's quality, per Cohere's documentation.

sources.title: Models at a glance - Amazon Bedrock

notes: Catalog lists no deprecation_date for this target, but Cohere's own docs state Command and Command Light were deprecated on September 15, 2025, and as of today (2026-09-24) neither model appears in Amazon Bedrock's current 'Models at a glance' listing, suggesting Bedrock access has also ended, though we found no Bedrock-specific EOL date or announcement to cite. No accuracy-style benchmark specific to Command Light was found on Cohere's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty.
